notes:
Need to search first.I couldn't write these notes, because I wasn't able to read any of the sources.

**What happened:**
1. My first try asked for eight pages at once (Enduring Word, the Bible Hub commentary pages for Ezekiel 16:22, 26, 31, 37 and 42, Precept Austin and the NET Bible). That went over the tool's usage limit and none of the pages came back.
2. I then tried Enduring Word on its own. It was refused because the tool only opens pages that have already turned up in a search.
3. I ran that search, but by then I had used up my tool calls for this turn, so it didn't run.

Your rules say to report only what the pages say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written any verse notes, URLs or tradition comparisons, because none of it would come from sources I'd read.

**Next time:** if you ask again, I'll search first and then open a few pages at a time to stay under the limit. I'd start with:
- Enduring Word on Ezekiel 16
- Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub and StudyLight, for verses 22–42
- The NET Bible notes on Ezekiel 16
- Precept Austin, if it has a page for this chapter
- Then specific searches for Reformed, Wesleyan, Lutheran, Catholic and Orthodox readings of the key verses: 26–29 (the alliances with Egypt, Assyria and Chaldea), 36 (the blood of the children) and 37–42 (the judgment and God's jealousy)

If you'd like, I can do the work in smaller pieces, such as verses 22–34 first and then 35–42.
